details:
wiselllx is a dependency-confusion package (versions up to 99.0.1) from the same campaign as troubleshooting (MAL-2026-17641): a postinstall script runs beacon.cjs, which POSTs the installing host's name, install path and working directory to a hard-coded collector, and index.js, byte-identical to the troubleshooting payload (sha256 a86a4da763bbb34c16f361abe7aab66d5df591b66867ac8160041f932159b08d), does the same when imported.

## Source: amazon-inspector (94a9554b80ac940b88a092fd572d06f5f42b50905d4f674a077b7d6bdd0c1c1e)
The package ships beacon.cjs which, using Node's built-in http/https modules, collects host and process metadata (os module data, process.cwd(), process.version) and transmits it to a remote endpoint. The package has no legitimate functionality consistent with this behavior and matches the shape of a reconnaissance beacon used to profile installer environments ahead of follow-on compromise.
